page.overview:
Who is Manjaro?

Manjaro is a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew and masqueraded as Zoro. When the crew switched to posing as the Kid Pirates, Manjaro impersonated Heat.

Manjaro is a man with a beer gut, chubby face, thick eyebrows, and thick lips. His hairstyle, earrings, and plain shirt are similar to those seen worn by the real Zoro, but otherwise, he is nothing like the real Zoro. He also wears a metal-studded belt, shorts with the number "34" on the left front side of it, and white shoes.

When impersonating Heat, Manjaro has shaggy hair with a similar stringed corset and pants.

Manjaro is friendly with Fake Sanji, unlike the real Zoro with Sanji. However he is loyal to Fake Luffy, automatically agreeing to forget about Fake Robin just after Fake Luffy ordered so. So far out of all the Fake Straw Hats, Fake Zoro (along with Fake Sanji) has shown to be one of the most intelligent of the impostors, quickly identifying the real Chopper, discerning that Luffy (in disguise) has a connection with the real Straw Hats, and luring him to Fake Luffy without arousing the Straw Hat's suspicion. Upon the truth coming out, he was discovered to be very cowardly, begging Caribou for mercy.
